prompt_used: A simple 2D cross-section diagram of a rectangular tank filled with fluid, containing two identical circles (representing spheres) side-by-side. The fluid surface is indicated by a simple horizontal dashed line at the top of the tank. The two circles are fully submerged in the fluid and are not touching each other. Required labels: 'X' placed clearly next to or inside the left circle, 'Y' placed clearly next to or inside the right circle, and 'fluid' with a simple leader line pointing to the empty space inside the tank. Illustrative only, not answer-bearing. Simple monochrome exam diagram. No unrequested arrows, symbols, or field patterns. No clutter. Clean black vector-like lines on a very light grey background. Times New Roman-like serif font.
